outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
cohort: The study participants are nulliparous pregnancies complicated by obesity.
finding: Induction of labor before 41 weeks does not improve outcomes in nulliparous pregnancies complicated by obesity, and increases the risk of Cesarean delivery and associated risks, including neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates.
mod_finding: Induction of labor before 41 weeks increases the risk of Cesarean delivery and NICU admission rates, though labor induction and scheduled Cesarean delivery have similar maternal and neonatal outcomes, and extreme obesity triples the risk of requiring Cesarean delivery.
